attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow is valid. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_ft_002
steps:
  - id: receive_food_entry
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: trigger.payload
      fields:
        - item_name
        - meal_type
        - calories
        - protein_g
        - carbs_g
        - fat_g
        - user_id
        - timestamp
    output: food_entry

  - id: validate_entry
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: food_entry
      schema:
        required:
          - item_name
          - meal_type
          - calories
          - protein_g
          - carbs_g
          - fat_g
          - user_id
          - timestamp
        properties:
          item_name:
            type: string
          meal_type:
            type: string
            enum:
              - breakfast
              - lunch
              - dinner
              - snack
          calories:
            type: number
            minimum: 0
          protein_g:
            type: number
            minimum: 0
          carbs_g:
            type: number
            minimum: 0
          fat_g:
            type: number
            minimum: 0
          user_id:
            type: string
          timestamp:
            type: string
            format: date-time
    output: validation_result

  - id: lookup_food_item
    op: read_database
    params:
      collection: nutrition_database
      query:
        item_name: food_entry.item_name
    output: nutrition_record

  - id: enrich_entry
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: food_entry
      mapping:
        item_name: food_entry.item_name
        meal_type: food_entry.meal_type
        calories: nutrition_record.calories || food_entry.calories
        protein_g: nutrition_record.protein_g || food_entry.protein_g
        carbs_g: nutrition_record.carbs_g || food_entry.carbs_g
        fat_g: nutrition_record.fat_g || food_entry.fat_g
        user_id: food_entry.user_id
        timestamp: food_entry.timestamp
    output: enriched_entry

  - id: store_log_entry
    op: write_database
    params:
      collection: nutrition_logs
      document:
        user_id: enriched_entry.user_id
        date: enriched_entry.timestamp
        item_name: enriched_entry.item_name
        meal_type: enriched_entry.meal_type
        calories: enriched_entry.calories
        protein_g: enriched_entry.protein_g
        carbs_g: enriched_entry.carbs_g
        fat_g: enriched_entry.fat_g
        timestamp: enriched_entry.timestamp
    output: stored_entry

  - id: fetch_daily_entries
    op: read_database
    params:
      collection: nutrition_logs
      query:
        user_id: enriched_entry.user_id
        date: enriched_entry.timestamp
    output: daily_entries

  - id: compute_daily_totals
    op: aggregate_data
    params:
      input: daily_entries
      operations:
        - field: calories
          function: sum
        - field: protein_g
          function: sum
        - field: carbs_g
          function: sum
        - field: fat_g
          function: sum
    output: daily_totals

  - id: store_daily_totals
    op: write_database
    params:
      collection: daily_nutrition_totals
      document:
        user_id: enriched_entry.user_id
        date: enriched_entry.timestamp
        total_calories: daily_totals.calories
        total_protein_g: daily_totals.protein_g
        total_carbs_g: daily_totals.carbs_g
        total_fat_g: daily_totals.fat_g
      upsert: true
    output: stored_totals
